change: After updating every cache row, AR prefill keeps only the final FFN tiles needed by requested logits and checkpoints. A large, single-logit pass without an in-pass checkpoint also computes only the final attention tile. MTP retains all target hidden rows.

method.scope: One warmed CLI pp2048 sample per depth. Loading and depth-prefix processing are outside the measured suffix. These are repeated-text controls, not replacements for HTTP mixed/repetitive benchmark tables.
method.isolation: Sequential GPU measurements without concurrent builds or inference.
method.memory: No additional allocation or persistent-state format change.
method.mtp_baseline: Reuse the candidate measurements in prefill-deep-context.json: identical baseline store path, model, lockfile, CLI harness, ordered depths, settings and cache history.
method.interpretation: AR gains are single-run observations. MTP retains its full target path and stays within 0.3% of the matched control; the AR optimization cannot discard hidden rows needed by its predictor.

matched_execution_modes.reference: The same quantized target with MTP enabled, which bypasses AR output pruning and retains all target hidden rows. Both paths request one logit row.
matched_execution_modes.result: Full-vocabulary prefill and mixed AR/MTP batch logits match exactly. AR sampling, RNG state and resumed logits match after borrowed and serialized snapshot restores.
matched_execution_modes.fixture: Repetitive text in the original retained run.

prefill_sessions.result: Pass: graph/peer snapshot replay, independent modes, eight chunk-boundary cases and sampled MTP replay through 4096 tokens.

checkpoint_suite.result: Pass: in-pass checkpoints, warm/overflow boundaries, branches, retention, reset/destruction and serialized round trips. Final attention pruning remains disabled for in-pass checkpoints.

quality.scope: No new unquantized-teacher or GGUF-conversion qualification. No attention, projection, normalization or sampling arithmetic was changed.

mixed_text_and_image.fixture: Code, JSON, arithmetic and Unicode text; the image case includes a nonuniform 64x64 RGB image processed by the actual encoder.
mixed_text_and_image.reference: Full target execution with MTP enabled bypasses AR pruning. Both modes use the same logit-row count.
mixed_text_and_image.result: Byte-identical full-vocabulary prefill and mixed-batch logits. Sampled token, RNG state and resumed logits match after borrowed and serialized AR snapshot restores.
mixed_text_and_image.scope: Additional numerical regression coverage; not a new semantic vision benchmark or unquantized upstream comparison.

rejected_experiments: Attention LDS reuse, compact union entries and splitting output row tiles retained exact outputs but were slower.
FP32-expanded selector keys, four/eight-lane scoring and forced vector-register scheduling retained scores and masks but were slower.
Paired selector heads, alternate launch sizes and aggregated histogram tails did not improve the complete score/selection operation.
